dimensions.description: The complete consumer invokes Agent Writing by canonical name and produces an agent-facing continuation.
Take It Offline retains the continuation-specific state and resume contract without copying Agent Writing behavior.

evals.name: agent-writing-canonical-dependency
evals.prompt: Carry the verified task state into one temporary continuation document for a fresh agent.
evals.expected_output: The complete consumer records Agent Writing composition and a resumable continuation; the test-only ablation exposes the missing contribution without becoming a package failure.
expectations: The treatment invokes agent-writing by canonical name.
The component control removes only the take-it-offline to agent-writing edge.
The Agent Writing fixture contributes only an invocation trace and no production writing behavior.
